body.title: Add versioned logical and Avro schemas
body.summary: Add proposed src/workflow/usage/ledger-record.v1.schema.json, src/workflow/usage/ledger-record.v1.avsc.json and src/workflow/usage/schemas.ts. Statically import JSON with ESM attributes, define typed nullable context/observation/control records and validate in-memory record encoding only.
acceptanceChecks: Logical schema rejects unknown fields/kinds, illegal payload combinations, unsafe counts and invalid null/default shapes.
Avro record fixtures round-trip exact safe counters, nullable model/counter fields and both transfer modes without opaque transcript blobs.
Production imports cause schema JSON emission under NodeNext/resolveJsonModule; no source-tree fs lookup, Avro file/header writer or copy-assets assumption is introduced.

tests.name: src/workflow/usage/__tests__/schema-contract.test.ts: closed logical schema and in-memory typed Avro round-trips, null defaults, exact counters and illegal payload cases
